prose: Politico reports that the White House asked OpenAI and Anthropic not to share new models with the UK's AI Security Institute until the US government has reviewed them - and that Anthropic appears to have agreed. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
highlights: White House asked OpenAI and Anthropic to withhold new models from UK AISI
Paywalled - summary based on headline and lead
